en: Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator, providing a safe, low-cost way to keep premature babies warm in rural Philippine hospitals.
The Department of Health officially endorses lagundi leaf extract as a safe and effective traditional medicine for treating coughs and asthma.
The local barangay government conducts quarterly earthquake drills to teach students the safe duck, cover, and hold evacuation procedure.
Republic Act 7610 is a child protection law that requires citizens to report suspected abuse to authorities to keep minors safe.
The Food and Nutrition Research Institute created the Pinggang Pinoy visual guide to help Filipino children eat balanced, healthy portions of local foods.
PAGASA issues color-coded rainfall warning signals to help local government units safely evacuate residents before severe typhoon floods occur.
The Filipino value of bayanihan promotes community health when neighbors volunteer together during local Philippine Red Cross blood donation drives.
Protecting the Philippine eagle's forest habitat maintains healthy watersheds, which prevents deadly mudslides and ensures clean drinking water for nearby towns.
The Mangyan indigenous people of Mindoro use traditional forest observations to predict weather changes, helping their communities safely prepare for typhoons.
Republic Act 10054 requires all motorcycle riders to wear standard protective headgear to prevent severe brain injuries during road accidents.
The Food and Drug Administration monitors local street food vendors during festivals to ensure meats are properly cooked and safe to eat.
The Department of Health translates vital vaccine information into regional languages like Cebuano and Ilocano so parents fully understand immunization safety.
